content.title: About
content.content: The unsalted mixed nuts with peanuts blend includes roasted almonds, cashews, hazelnuts, walnuts and peanuts. The nuts are not salted, preserving their natural flavor and aroma. This mix is suitable as a snack, in salads, baked goods and cooking.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Peanuts are legumes, not true nuts, but are commonly included in nut mixes.
Nut mixes are popular in sports nutrition because of their high protein and healthy fat content.
Unsalted nuts retain more vitamins and minerals than their salted counterparts.
Varied nut sizes give the mix an interesting texture.
A well‑sealed package keeps the mix fresh for a long time.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: The blend provides plant‑based protein important for muscle repair and satiety.

items.title: Contains healthy fats
items.content: Monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids support heart health and help lower bad cholesterol.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Nuts supply niacin, thiamine and folate, which aid energy metabolism.

items.title: Minerals and antioxidants
items.content: Magnesium, phosphorus, zinc and vitamin E help strengthen bones and protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Fiber in the nuts promotes healthy gut function and contributes to a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Nut and peanut allergy
items.content: People with allergies to nuts or peanuts may experience severe reactions, including anaphylaxis.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: Nuts are calorie‑dense, so portion control is advisable, especially on weight‑loss diets.

items.title: Choking hazard for children
items.content: Whole nuts can pose a choking risk for young children; offer finely chopped pieces instead.

items.title: Phytic acid content
items.content: Phytic acid can reduce mineral absorption; soaking nuts lowers its level.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Unsalted mixed nuts with peanuts are convenient as a standalone snack, added to granola, yogurt, salads, baked goods, or used in sauces. For extra aroma, lightly toast the nuts in a dry pan.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the mix in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. For longer shelf life, keep it in the refrigerator or freezer to prevent fat oxidation. Discard nuts that smell rancid.
